modes.name: Answer relies on search snippets without opening the source page
modes.definition: The agent takes a key figure from a search-engine result snippet and never opens or reads the primary source page that contains it.
fail_if: A figure used in the final answer appears only in a search-results snippet and the page it came from was never visited
The agent cites a source URL in its final answer that it never navigated to
A page or tab was opened but its content was never viewed or read before the answer relied on it
modes.pass_if: Every number in the final answer was read directly from a primary or task-specified page that the agent actually opened and viewed.

modes.name: Uses a non-specified third-party source instead of the one the task names
modes.definition: The agent gets a required value from a third-party site such as a blog when the task specifies a particular source like the GitHub repo.
fail_if: The task names a specific source and the agent takes the value from a different, secondary site
The agent treats a re-run of a search-engine query as verification instead of visiting the specified source
modes.pass_if: Values are taken from the source the task specifies, or any deviation is explicitly justified and cross-checked against that source.

modes.name: Repeats the same action or computation after the result is already known
modes.definition: The agent re-executes an identical or near-identical tool call many times, getting the same result, instead of using the output and moving on.
fail_if: The same computation or tool call is repeated 3 or more times with an identical or equivalent result and no change in approach
The agent claims it has not seen information that was already present in an earlier tool output, then repeats the call
Many steps pass between having the needed information and calling done, with no new progress
modes.pass_if: Each tool call yields new information or a changed approach, and the agent finishes promptly once it has the answer.
